references.text: The context of the Jubilee year - the fiftieth year shall be holy, and you shall not sow or harvest what grows of itself
God's promise of blessing in the sixth year, so that the crop will last until the Jubilee year when you eat from the produce of the land
The holiness of the Jubilee year and its significance for the redemption of land and property
The Sabbath year where the land shall rest and the poor may eat what grows of itself in the field
Reference to the Jubilee year in connection with inheritance and property rights in Israel
The prophet Ezekiel mentions the Jubilee year (the year of release) in connection with the prince and property
Prophetic fulfillment of the Jubilee's liberation - to proclaim a year of favor from the Lord
Jesus quotes Isaiah 61 and proclaims the fulfillment of the spiritual meaning of the Jubilee - the Lord's year of favor
